observed_frozen_dependencies.finding: _tail hard-codes the first appended row to Joern05, permits at most two rows, and requires CodeQL01 only as the second row after a completed Joern05.
observed_frozen_dependencies.consequence: The current continuation source cannot truthfully schedule a CodeQL-only first tail row.

observed_frozen_dependencies.finding: _selected starts from 82 completed prefix groups and finalizes only after adding both tail rows, requiring 84 selected groups.
observed_frozen_dependencies.consequence: A CodeQL-only successor needs a separate selected-group expectation of 83 and one-tail validation.

observed_frozen_dependencies.finding: _context_for_row already has a CodeQL01 identity branch, but it requires the row contract SHA to equal the repaired continuation context.
observed_frozen_dependencies.consequence: The successor must create and bind a dedicated CodeQL continuation contract/source/plan context; it cannot reuse the old contract SHA or relabel a historical row.

observed_frozen_dependencies.finding: execute requires an admission receipt, exact plan HEAD, retained preflight verification, then rejects a no-tail CodeQL call and accepts CodeQL only after a completed Joern05 tail row.
observed_frozen_dependencies.consequence: The CodeQL-only successor needs a separate dispatch gate that admits exactly one CodeQL row from the sealed 88-row prefix.

observed_frozen_dependencies.finding: validate derives a Joern repaired context and _derive_context requires Joern maximum_attempts=5 plus fresh Joern qualification evidence.
observed_frozen_dependencies.consequence: Calling continuation-06 validate for CodeQL-only execution would create a false Joern dependency and cannot certify this independent path.

observed_frozen_dependencies.finding: _validate_tail_identity checks fixture, source, plan, contract, argv, and output-root identity for CodeQL01.
observed_frozen_dependencies.consequence: The new CodeQL row must carry exact new-context source/plan/contract identity while retaining the frozen CodeQL command and report partitions.

observed_frozen_dependencies.finding: The admission checker requires no expiry, exact authority/review/artifact bindings, retained replay, phase reserves, resource floor, exclusive lock, fresh namespaces, and materialized-source fields.
observed_frozen_dependencies.consequence: The CodeQL-only admission must preserve those guards, bind one fresh CodeQL namespace, and retain the typed 30 GiB aggregate/12 GiB projection limits.

minimal_successor_design.manifest_schema: new append-only CodeQL-only continuation schema with one permitted tail row

codeql_identity.command: retain the frozen CodeQL Swift argv and query receipt, with only the reviewed continuation source/plan/contract identity and a fresh output namespace
codeql_identity.output_root_condition: must be absent before admission and created only by the future actual attempt
codeql_identity.fixture_revision: must equal the exact continuation manifest fixture_revision

contract_delta: derive from the frozen/base CodeQL group and preserve every unrelated group, tool, version, resource, timeout, reserve, and report partition
bind a new source commit, plan commit, contract SHA, query receipt, and continuation source closure
retain no-expiry policy with finite per-attempt lease derived from the registered CodeQL deadline plus reviewed startup allowance
retain aggregate source-working authorization at 30 GiB and materialized-source projection at 12 GiB
do not add Joern05 max-attempt authority, repaired Joern qualification, or a Joern execution row

required_preconditions_before_any_admiss: A separately reviewed CodeQL-only source module and focused tests exist; continuation-06 is not used as the production scheduler because its Joern-first checks are incompatible.
A dedicated CodeQL successor contract is committed and source/plan/contract ancestry plus every source-input SHA is verified.
The CodeQL plan, query receipt, fixture revision, argv, environment, output roots, and report partitions are independently hash-bound.
A final manifest and independent review bind the exact successor source/plan/contract and sealed 88-row prefix; no final qualification or selected-group count is inferred from historical rows.

An admission receipt rechecks exact HEAD, frozen base validation at the 88-row boundary, lock/slot/PID/resource gates, no-expiry authority, 30 GiB aggregate working cap, 12 GiB source projection, fresh output namespace, and one-shot CodeQL attempt state.
No CodeQL output, ledger row, or completion receipt is treated as present until a future authorized actual attempt writes and verifies it.
required_near_misses: CodeQL as the first tail row passed to continuation-06 must reject or route only to the dedicated successor; it must not be accepted by weakening _tail.
A Joern05 row, Joern success claim, or selected_groups=84 value in the CodeQL-only packet must reject.
A reused contract-08 SHA, old source/plan identity, changed CodeQL argv, query receipt, fixture, report partition, or output root must reject.
A pre-existing output namespace, stale admission, missing lock/resource gate, missing exact HEAD, expired user-window field, or automatic retry must reject.
A source projection over 12 GiB or aggregate working projection over 30 GiB must reject before attempt namespace creation.
nonclaims: No CodeQL attempt, receipt, ledger row, report, score, or qualification result was created by this design.
This design does not certify the current frozen CodeQL output namespace as consumed or fresh beyond the read-only absence check recorded here.
The 82 completed historical groups remain the only completed-prefix evidence; 83 is a prospective post-success denominator.
